# The editor-drag arm presses beside the editor before its theme lands

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` › *a drag inside the editor selects text instead of drag-scrolling the grid* fails under load with "the grid did not scroll — Expected 0, Received 140+". Defect-noted 2026-09-19 at 2/60 on `dev`'s `Body.mjs` in a same-head control (#18955's PR, which it is not). Measured now, at `dev@0e3fb712ff`, with a scratch copy of the arm at `--repeat-each=60 --workers=12`.

## The Problem

The arm reads the editor input's bounding box and presses 6 px inside its right edge. Under load it reads the box **before the text field's theme has landed**:

| outcome | the input's box when read | element under the press point (`elementFromPoint`) |
|---|---|---|
| fail | x 455, **w 153, h 21** | `DIV.neo-grid-cell`, not inside the editor |
| pass | x 456, **w 117, h 25** | `INPUT.neo-textfield-input` |

153 × 21 is Chromium's default size for an unstyled text `<input>`. The unthemed input overflows its 150 px column, so the press point lands 2 px into the next cell. The arm then drag-scrolls a plain cell, which is the positive control's gesture, not the one under test. The input's box never moves between the read and the press, so this is not a re-render race. The arm measures a pre-theme box, and its precondition — a press that starts inside the editor — is assumed rather than established.

## The Fix

Before pressing, poll until the element under the press point is inside `.neo-grid-editor`, re-reading the box on each poll. The arm then tests what its title claims. The plugin and the theme are untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The arm establishes its press target inside the editor before `mouse.down()`.
- [ ] The arm passes 60 of 60 at `--repeat-each=60 --workers=12`, where it failed several times before.
- [ ] With the precondition removed, the same load reproduces the failure (the fix is the precondition, not luck).

## Out of Scope

- The first editor's brief pre-theme render itself. Neo loads a class's theme CSS when its first instance is created, so the first text field of a session can paint unstyled for a moment. That is a property of lazy theme loading, not of cell editing.
